## NCAA Freshman & Redshirt Freshman Champions

Winning an NCAA Division I wrestling title as a freshman is one of collegiate sports' rarest achievements. This chart displays modern true freshman champions alongside notable redshirt freshman title winners.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

freshman_champs <- tribble(
  ~year, ~wrestler, ~school, ~weight, ~type,
  1979, "Darryl Burley", "Lehigh", "134 lb", "True Freshman",
  1990, "Pat Smith", "Oklahoma State", "158 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  1999, "Cael Sanderson", "Iowa State", "184 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2003, "Teyon Ware", "Oklahoma", "141 lb", "True Freshman",
  2006, "Dustin Schlatter", "Minnesota", "149 lb", "True Freshman",
  2010, "Kyle Dake", "Cornell", "141 lb", "True Freshman",
  2012, "Logan Stieber", "Ohio State", "133 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2014, "J'den Cox", "Missouri", "197 lb", "True Freshman",
  2014, "Jason Tsirtsis", "Northwestern", "149 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2015, "Nathan Tomasello", "Ohio State", "125 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2015, "Isaiah Martinez", "Illinois", "157 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2016, "Myles Martin", "Ohio State", "174 lb", "True Freshman",
  2017, "Mark Hall", "Penn State", "174 lb", "True Freshman",
  2017, "Vincenzo Joseph", "Penn State", "165 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2017, "Bo Nickal", "Penn State", "184 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2018, "Spencer Lee", "Iowa", "125 lb", "True Freshman",
  2018, "Yianni Diakomihalis", "Cornell", "141 lb", "True Freshman",
  2019, "Mekhi Lewis", "Virginia Tech", "165 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2021, "AJ Ferrari", "Oklahoma State", "197 lb", "True Freshman",
  2021, "David Carr", "Iowa State", "157 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2021, "Carter Starocci", "Penn State", "174 lb", "Redshirt Freshman",
  2021, "Aaron Brooks", "Penn State", "184 lb", "Redshirt Freshman"
)

yearly_champs <- freshman_champs |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    # Build hover details listing the wrestler names, schools, weights, and status
    details = paste(
      paste0("• ", wrestler, " (", school, ", ", weight, " — ", type, ")"),
      collapse = "<br>"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_ly(
  data = yearly_champs,
  x = ~year,
  y = ~total,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  marker = list(size = 10, color = "#2c7fb8"),
  line = list(color = "#2c7fb8", width = 2.5),
  text = ~details,
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "<b>Year: %{x}</b><br>",
    "Champions: %{y}<br><br>",
    "%{text}<extra></extra>"
  ),
  height = 500
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "NCAA Division I Freshman Champions by Year (1979–2026)"),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      dtick = 5,
      range = c(1978, 2026.5)
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Champions", dtick = 1, rangemode = "tozero")
  )
```
